dossier.headline: Banks lead the market to a nine-month high for Nifty Bank
dossier.summary: Bank stocks have led India's rallies through November, carried by foreign buying into heavyweight lenders: on November 6 ICICI Bank rose 4.65% and HDFC Bank 3.56% in a late surge. On November 11 the Nifty Bank index rose over 2% to a nine-month high, near its 52-week peak, with all 14 constituents higher and Bank of Baroda the top gainer, holding the benchmarks positive as other sectors were sold.
why_it_matters: Banks are the largest weight in the Nifty, so their strength decides the index's direction
Foreign investors have favoured lenders in this month's buying
